highlights.reason_zh: Qwen Code 将受控本地访问和企业消息带入稳定版，也扩大了 agent 权限面；目录授权、破坏性操作与消息投递需要生产形态回归。
highlights.reason_en: Qwen Code brings controlled local access and enterprise messaging to stable while expanding agent authority; directory grants, destructive actions and delivery need production-shaped tests.

highlights.reason_zh: Qwen Concept 27B 的公开权重、代码、数据与随机对照让争议方法可复测；证据足以从 IGNORE 升到 TRIAL，但尚不能改训练路线。
highlights.reason_en: Qwen Concept 27B makes a disputed method reproducible with public weights, code, data and a random control; evidence supports TRIAL, not a training-strategy change.

highlights.reason_zh: Sophon-Realtime 公开权重、代码与兼容 OpenAI Realtime 的试用 API，降低全双工语音试验门槛；延迟和质量数字仍为厂商自报。
highlights.reason_en: Sophon-Realtime lowers the full-duplex voice trial barrier with public weights, code and an OpenAI Realtime-compatible API; latency and quality remain publisher-reported.

highlights.reason_zh: Inkling 2 Small 提供开放多模态权重和托管入口，但 500 GB 起步的原生显存需求决定了多数团队应先走 API。
highlights.reason_en: Inkling 2 Small offers open multimodal weights and hosted access, while a 500 GB native memory floor means most teams should start through an API.

highlights.reason_zh: LiteLLM 1.108.9 缩小 LTS 与主线的 reasoning、缓存和路由差距；provider 转换面广，升级前仍需 canary。
highlights.reason_en: LiteLLM 1.108.9 narrows LTS gaps in reasoning, caching and routing; broad provider translations still require a canary before rollout.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部成功并读完，并主动检索模型、开源、小团队、研究、开发工具、基础设施、政策与重大综合新闻。召回自检补出 Inkling、Sophon、Qwen Concept 与 DeepSeek V3 JAX；前三者作为 late discovery 入库，后者因仅具教学价值明确标为 IGNORE。三个模型或方法的性能仍为发布方自报，尚未独立复现；部分研究页面只有日期精度。本轮没有重大综合新闻补充。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded and were read, with active discovery across models, open source, small teams, research, developer tools, infrastructure, policy and major general news. Recall audit recovered Inkling, Sophon, Qwen Concept and DeepSeek V3 JAX; the first three entered as late discoveries, while the educational-only JAX project was explicitly marked IGNORE. Performance claims for the three model or method entries remain publisher-reported and independently unreplicated; some research pages have date-only precision. No major general-news supplement was selected.
